title: Gladiator Underground
description: Two brothers compete in the world's deadliest underground fighting tournament, where they must decide whether to play by the rules or to cast their honor aside and team up to bring down the dark syndicate running the tournament.

title: A Force of One
description: A veteran (Chuck Norris) teaches martial arts to a California detective (Jennifer O'Neill) and her colleagues, and joins them on a case.

title: Timecop
description: In 1994 a 2004 Washington policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) saves his wife (Mia Sara) and stops a sinister senator from buying the presidency.

title: Speed Kills
description: A wealthy speedboat racer leads a double life that gets him into trouble with the law and drug lords.

title: Children of the Corn: Genesis
description: Seeking refuge at a secluded compound, a couple (Kelen Coleman, Tim Rock) encounters a mysterious cult that worships a possessed boy.

title: Children of the Corn: Runaway
description: A pregnant woman escapes a murderous child cult in a small town and spends the next decade living anonymously to protect her son. After they move to a new town, she realizes something evil is following them, and she must confront it to save them.

title: Candyman 3
description: A woman (Donna D'Errico) tries to disprove a legend that her ancestor (Tony Todd) can appear and kill people with his hook.

title: Alone in the Dark
description: A paranormal investigator (Christian Slater), an anthropologist (Tara Reid) and a team of agents battle deadly monsters.

title: Brain Dead
description: A corporate man (Bill Paxton) tempts a doctor (Bill Pullman) to pick a secret formula from a crazed scientist's (Bud Cort) brain.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E05 — Filming Begins
The filmmakers meet with Robert to get advice pertaining to their upcoming shoots, which leads BK to question if she really needs the creative help she hired, or if her first movie making experience should be braved alone.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E01 — Opening Night
Three months after freeing Santanico from the Titty Twister, the Gecko Brothers are still on the run; Seth and Kate are lost in Mexico; Richie and Santanico plot vengeance on the culebra Lord.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E02 — In a Dark Time
Seth and Kate pull off a heist; Ranger Gonzalez confronts nightmarish visions; Carlos's emergence from the Labyrinth.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E03 — Attack of the 50 ft. Sex Machine
Richie and Santanico pose as sex traffickers to infiltrate Malvado's food supply, while Sonja forces Seth to kick his drug habit. Meanwhile, Freddie faces off with Sex Machine.

title: The Doorman
description: A former soldier must save her niece and nephew from armed thieves planning to steal priceless art from a building in New York City.

title: BloodRayne
description: A vampire hybrid joins the fight against the evil bloodsucker who sired her.

title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
description: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward).

title: BloodRayne: The Third Reich
description: Half-vampire, half-human Rayne must stop a Nazi official and his army of walking dead before they can carry out their plan to make Hitler immortal.

title: Missing in Action
description: A U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) escapes from the Viet Cong, then comes back with a floating arsenal to get others out.

title: Missing in Action 2: The Beginning
description: An imprisoned U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) fights the military overlord (Oh Soon-tek) of a slave-labor opium operation in Vietnam.

title: Braddock: Missing in Action III
description: A U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) returns to Vietnam and fights his way out with his wife, son (Roland Harrah III) and Amerasian orphans.

title: Empire State
description: A security guard (Liam Hemsworth) and his childhood pal (Michael Angarano) make plans to rob an armored car.

title: Safe
description: A young girl whose memory holds a priceless numerical code, finds herself pursued. Coming to her aid is an ex-cage fighter whose life was destroyed by the gangsters on Mei's trail.

title: Redemption
description: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

title: Machete Kills
description: The president recruits ex-Federale Machete to take down an eccentric arms dealer who plans to spread war and anarchy throughout the world.

title: American Sicario
description: American gangster Erik Vasquez schemes to become the top dog in the Mexican underworld, only to find himself making enemies out of both the powerful cartels and his own allies.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E04 — The Best Little Horror House In Texas
Kate hunts down Scott in Bethel; Richie and Santanico find themselves deep in the flesh trade; Seth tries to get back on Uncle Eddie's good side.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E05 — Bondage
The Gecko brothers finally call a truce and work together to find Malvado's headquarters; Carlos, unhinged from the Labyrinth, abducts Santanico and claims her for himself.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E06 — Bizarre Tales
Freddie and Kate follow the trail of a mass grave to Oculto, a reclusive and dangerous Lord.

title: Drive Angry 3D

title: Dog Soldiers
description: A pack of werewolves targets a squad of soldiers (Sean Pertwee, Kevin McKidd) on a training exercise in the Scottish Highlands.

title: The Delta Force

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:

Richie and Seth hatch a plan to complete Santanico's revenge; Freddie and Kate face an unexpected foe.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E08 — The Last Temptation Of Richard Gecko
The uneasy truce between brothers and partners falls apart in light of new betrayals.
